shared_elements: dense field of small pictorial script signs
glyph signs arranged in horizontal rows/bands
justification: Both surfaces combine a carved figure in relief with an extensive field of small pictorial script signs set out in horizontal rows, which is a real but broad correspondence. The forms differ sharply: A is dominated by a single large, elaborately costumed standing figure with an ornate curvilinear headdress and interlaced masks, with glyphs confined to a basal band, whereas B is overwhelmingly text in sparse, isolated linear signs with only a small subordinate figure above the rows.
